Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE measures Treasury volatility and term-premium stress: below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress. At 102.56 it is moderate, down from 105.20. SOFR at 3.90% describes secured overnight funding, not a stand-alone stress verdict. NFCI -0.494 means broad financial conditions are looser than average, although less loose than the revised prior week. The 10Y yield rose 1 bp to 5.28%.

Fed & Policy Watch
Waller speaks on the economic outlook at 4:30 AM ET today. The 30-year reopening closes competitively at 1 PM; distinguish Treasury duration-demand risk from bill funding operations. September CPI is Oct 14 and PPI / retail sales are Oct 15 at 8:30 AM. The Board sets the Oct 14 Beige Book at 2 PM ET; Chicago lists 3 PM, so the central Board time governs. Oct 12 is a Fed holiday and SIFMA fixed-income close recommendation, while NYSE remains scheduled open and CME U.S. repo is closed; this can thin rates/equity cross-market liquidity.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar conflict check completed for Oct 8-15: CPI is not PPI; NFCI is holiday-shifted to Oct 15; petroleum inventories are Oct 15 at noon, not Wednesday. Elapsed events, including Oct 7 minutes, are removed. No BEA release is scheduled in this window.
  • BLS monthly schedule returned 403. Current official CPI and PPI pages were inspected and confirm their dates/times. Other BLS releases are omitted without date-specific verification. DOL calendar returned 403; jobless claims are omitted rather than inferred.
  • EIA secure gas report returned 403, but its public storage table explicitly confirms Oct 8; the official release schedule supplies 10:30 AM ET. The upcoming reference week is unconfirmed. Oct 15 gas and heating-oil/propane rows are omitted because an exact next-release date was not verified.
  • Treasury tentative schedule identifies Oct 13 bill auctions, Oct 14 17-week and Oct 15 4/8-week auctions, but final notices/times were not available at cutoff, so no timed rows are invented. Watch bill issuance Oct 8/13 and coupon issuance Oct 15 as date-only liquidity flows; no settlement clock is assumed.
  • Specific weekly option-expiry rows are omitted: no current date-specific contract listing was inspected. The official annual calendar was checked for market-structure context.
  • CARTS, wholesale trade and NFCI classifier names are provisional Medium and reviewed as secondary indicators; their provisional notes remain visible. Policy, geopolitical and supply-disruption risks are unscheduled watch items, not claimed current developments or invented calendar rows. WTI is up 1.93% overnight; do not infer a cause from the quote.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
ES is modestly lower overnight, Treasury yields edged higher, MOVE eased within the moderate band and broad conditions remain loose. Treat Waller, the long-bond auction and the energy release as repricing windows; wait for price and rates confirmation. This is a scenario framework, not a directional recommendation.
INVALIDATION
Reassess on a sustained break of the observed overnight range with confirming rates/volatility repricing, unexpectedly weak auction demand, or a material policy surprise. No unverified range levels or price targets are supplied. CPI and retail sales are the next High-impact scheduled catalysts.
